children: FingerMotion announced a non-binding three-party MOU with Lyken.AI and BlueFlare and provided an update on Alberta corridor gas-supply discussions.
Entered a non-binding, non-exclusive MOU with Lyken.AI and BlueFlare to match enterprise AI demand with modular behind-the-meter capacity.
Framework focuses on Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan and supplements prior FingerMotion–BlueFlare development plans.
FingerMotion completed a 9.9% Lyken equity acquisition on Aug 17, 2026; Alset AI retains 90.1% controlling interest.
Company is negotiating potential firm natural gas supply arrangements for corridor sites; no definitive supply agreement yet.
Projects will be evaluated site-by-site requiring site control, fuel supply, customer offtake, financing and approvals; MOU contains no financing commitments.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: FingerMotion announces non-binding MOU with Lyken.AI and BlueFlare, updates Alberta gas-supply talks
